news.casting_brief: NASA astrophysics director, scrappy startup founders and engineers, mission controllers; high-stakes public-private gamble to save a dying mission.
news.script_brief: NASA gives a young startup under a year to build a rescue satellite that will chase, grab with robotic arms, and reboost a failing $500M telescope before it falls. Tension: impossible deadline, tight budget, unproven feat. Hooks: the cold pitch, the green light, the launch, the latch attempt.
news.news_close_brief: A startup raced to build a first-of-its-kind rescue craft to catch a falling astronomy satellite and lift it to safety. Whether the daring catch succeeds remains to be seen.

dramatic_state.dramatic_question: Can Katalyst's unproven satellite chase, grab, and reboost the failing $500M telescope before the deadline forces a launch the arms aren't ready for?
dramatic_state.character_a_wants: Launch Katalyst's rescue satellite on NASA's under-a-year deadline, no slips
dramatic_state.character_b_wants: Delay the Wallops Island launch until the three robotic arms can safely latch
dramatic_state.ending_change: The satellite launches on time and its three robotic arms latch the telescope, proving the impossible feat and Domagal-Goldman's gamble.
